notes: Novo Banco (NB) homebanking movements as Excel (the real file is an old .xls; written as .xlsx). Sparsely documented: one importer requires the header Data Operação | Data Valor | Descrição | Débito | Crédito and treats "-" as an empty amount; a business profile says the header is on row 2 and names the amount columns "Débito (€)" / "Crédito (€)" with a "Montante (€)" and "Tipo". This file uses the plain names, one title row (its wording is a placeholder), date cells, POSITIVE debits and credits in separate columns with "-" on the empty side, newest first. No balance column is documented, so none here; currency never stated.
